cues.zh: 我十六岁那年，父亲允许我去
cues.en: I was sixteen years old and my father allowed me to go
I had just turned seventeen at the time

cues.zh: 他们来到我们这里时，还是受惊的孩子，必须被训练成士兵
cues.en: When they came to us they were frightened children and had to be made into soldiers

cues.zh: 好了小伙子们，来了，我们要上镜头了
cues.en: Alright boys, here it comes, we're in the pictures

cues.zh: 我把青春的每一部分都献给了这份工作
cues.en: I gave every part of my youth to do a job

cues.zh: 把这段战壕延伸到那边去
cues.en: Extend this part of the trench over there

cues.zh: 有任务要完成，你就只管继续干下去
cues.en: There was a job to be done and you'd just go on and did it
